title: Units, Open-Reservation Allowance, Launch Opening and Allocation Settings — Pre-Orders & Back-Orders
content:
Pre-Orders & Back-Orders limits how many units one reservation may carry, how many reservations a customer may keep open, when a launch opens, and the order in which arriving stock is set aside. The settings below are fixed per reservation type.

| | Standard Back-Order | Supplier Direct Back-Order | Seasonal Pre-Order | Launch Pre-Order | Deposit Pre-Order | Made-to-Order Reservation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Most units on one reservation | 5 | 5 | 5 | 1 | 3 | 1 |
| Limit capping open units of one style per customer | Most units on one reservation | Most units on one reservation | Most units on one reservation | Launch pre-order per-style limit of the customer's Marlowe Rewards tier | Most units on one reservation | Most units on one reservation |
| Most open reservations one customer may hold across all types | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Marlowe Rewards early access lets members reserve before the public opening | No | No | No | Yes | No | No |
| Public opening time on the launch date (Eastern Time) | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | 10:00 | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Order in which arriving stock is allocated | Reservation time | Reservation time | Reservation time | Marlowe Rewards priority, then reservation time | Reservation time | Reservation time |
| Reservations the stock cannot cover | Delay notice | Delay notice | Delay notice | Cancelled unallocated, with a full refund | Delay notice | Delay notice |

**Notes**

- An open reservation is one in status reserved, awaiting consent, in production or allocated. The allowance of 10 counts open reservations of every type together.
- The Launch Pre-Order is the only type whose per-style cap follows the customer's Marlowe Rewards tier rather than the unit cap of a single reservation. It is also the only type with early access and a public opening time (10:00 Eastern Time on the launch date), and the only type allocated by Marlowe Rewards priority first.
- When stock falls short, a Launch Pre-Order reservation that stock cannot cover is cancelled with a full refund. Every other type receives a delay notice instead.
